title: Semantic Webcam — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Semantic Webcam's rich face: card 03 live where the line of iterations names it, its pipeline walked on a still where the page says how it works, and the carried question measured where the page keeps its lost branches, with the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.title: Character Multiply Cam · card 03, the anchor, live
pieces.caption: The anchor on your own face. Brightness picks the glyph; whole words fill the mid-tone runs; the highlights are white tiles with black letters. **g** swaps words for blocks, **space** freezes. The camera grant for this card is Loudon's, from 2026-10-21; nothing is recorded.

pieces.by: the Maker · canvas · card 03's engine on a still
pieces.title: the ramp · card 03's pipeline, walked up on a still
pieces.caption: Five steps on the Grace Hopper still (or soft waves): a grid of greys, the ramp, words into runs, smoothing under a modelled camera noise, and the test. Squinting one cell, the drawn frame follows the source at r +0.87, the shuffled control at −0.01. Inside the word band it is +0.03: 03 selects by light and draws every letter at one brightness, where the section says it multiplies.

pieces.by: the Maker · canvas · the carried question, measured
pieces.title: legibility band · is legibility a band of light?
pieces.caption: One letter is one grey; the capitals span only 0.11–0.23 of a cell; punched into white they make a second band near 0.8–0.9, and on the Hopper still those tiles carry 45% of the frame's light. Then the test: inside 03's word band the drawn light stays flat (r +0.03), words picked by ink lift it to +0.23, light alone to +0.53.

pieces.title: Tonal Bench · card 08, the steward's measurement
pieces.caption: The steward's own answer, from cycle 10: card 05's word picker run on the same still, grammar against tonal fit against a random-target control, 48 renders each. Line match +0.02 → +0.49, control +0.00; patch match only +0.04 → +0.17. Runs in the page in about two seconds; no camera.

pieces.title: Anatomy Cam · card 07, proof frame
pieces.caption: Where *detect true eyes and fingers* went: each tracked feature gets its own text inside the tonal picture, seeing on the eyes (cyan), speech on the mouth (rose), touch on the hand (green). The features here were placed by hand on a still, since the headless camera has no face in it; nobody has yet stood in front of card 07.
pieces.near: Compose real lines that fit the blobs

offers.what: The section says 'the camera-luminance × character-ink multiply is literally a Convolution-flavored blend'. Card 03 doesn't multiply: a cell's light selects a tier, every word letter is drawn at one fixed brightness (alpha 0.94), and the ink table 03 measures is never read in its render. Measured on the Hopper still (squint 1 cell), the whole frame follows the source at r +0.87 (shuffled control −0.01), but inside the word band r is +0.03 and drawn light rises 0.03 per unit of source light. A literal multiply would give the band +0.53 (slope 0.18) and the whole frame +0.82. What 03 does is select by brightness band, a mask, and a pointwise product isn't a convolution in any case (it is convolution's dual under the Fourier transform). The same wording is in The line of iterations bullet, in the deck's card 03, and in Language as a Tonal Medium's step 3. Offer: say 'brightness selects the glyph', or have the steward make 03 actually multiply.

'Temporal smoothing settles the words near-still.' In a model (the Hopper still, Gaussian cell noise σ 0.02, which is an assumption and not measured off a webcam), 27% of the word letters change each frame at 03's default smooth of 0.7, 62% at 0 and 6% at 0.95. Each run's words are seeded by the run's index along its row, so a run that splits or joins reseeds every run to its right, and whole rows turn over at once. Offer: say the smoothing calms the words rather than stills them, or have the steward seed words by run position rather than run index. Not checked on a real camera.

The carried question now has a measured answer the bullet could carry: legibility is two bands of light. The capitals span ink 0.11–0.23 of a cell (L lightest, N heaviest, in the browser's monospace font); punched into a white tile they span 0.77–0.89. Across 03's word band (B 0.26 to 0.80) the drawn light stays between 0.16 and 0.22, flat. Inside the band, words picked by ink alone lift the patch match from +0.03 to +0.23, against the steward's +0.17 with grammar kept (card 08), so language carries tone there, but faintly.
'Possibly its own future entry' is out of date: it is [[Language as a Tonal Medium]], as Forward Vectors already says. Offer: link it there.

'The line of iterations above stops at card 03 of eight' was true on 2026-10-24. The deck now holds ten cards: card 09 (the reactive cam) and card 10 (the sitting cam) shipped 2026-11-03. Offer: 'of ten'.
